age.evidence: Male Sprague Dawley rats (Charles River, Sulzfeld, Germany) weighing ~250 g on arrival

sex.evidence: Male Sprague Dawley rats... Of the 20 rats that were initially trained, 13 animals... were used

dosing.evidence: LSD (0.08 mg/kg given intraperitoneally (i.p.))... dissolved in sterile water... Animals were trained daily (Monday-Friday) under a double alternating sequence, with at least two LSD and two vehicle sessions per week

handling.evidence: During this time, the animals were frequently handled.

group_housing.evidence: group housed in the standard laboratory cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-hour light/dark cycle (lights on: 6:00am)... Behavioural tests were carried out during the light phase of the light/dark cycle.

assays.assay_description: Operant chambers (Coulbourn E1010RF) equipped with two levers; rats trained on FR10 schedule to discriminate 0.08 mg/kg LSD (i.p., 15 min pre-session) from vehicle. Dose-response (0.01–0.08 mg/kg LSD), time-response (5, 15, 30, 90 min), and antagonist combination tests (ketanserin, MDL 100907, SB 699551, ASP 5736) were conducted. Test sessions were non-reinforced, terminated after 10 consecutive presses on either lever or 5 min.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were freshly prepared before administration and given i.p. in a volume of 1 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: At least one hour before the start of the experiment, rats were transferred to the experimental room for acclimation. (room habituation only)

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were placed in the operant box; freely moving during operant sessions.

food_restriction.evidence: mild food restriction (~17 g of food pellets per day) for at least one week prior to training... Standard laboratory chow (17 g/day per animal) was provided around one hour after the training or testing sessions

time_to_assay.evidence: LSD was given 15 minutes before the beginning of testing.

sample_size.evidence: Of the 20 rats that were initially trained, 13 animals... were used... only some (n=10-13) animals were taken for testing

outcomes.summary: LSD produced dose-related increases in LSD-lever selection (ED50 = 0.0384 mg/kg), with LSD-appropriate responding observed at 5–30 min but not 90 min post-injection. The 5-HT2A antagonists ketanserin (2 mg/kg, partial antagonism) and MDL 100907 (0.1–2 mg/kg, full antagonism), as well as the 5-HT5A antagonists SB 699551 (3, 10 mg/kg, full antagonism) and ASP 5736 (0.01 mg/kg, partial antagonism, inverted U-shape), attenuated the LSD discriminative cue.
outcomes.statistics: ED50 = 0.0384 (95% CI 0.025–0.051) mg/kg; time-response: χ²=22.29, df=1, p<0.017; response rate ANOVAs: F(5,50)=1.01 NS; F(3,47)=1.23 NS; F(5,61)=2.92 p<0.05; F(4,49)=3.73 p<0.01; antagonist chi-square tests p<0.0125.
outcomes.evidence: LSD produced dose-related increases in response, with an ED50 of 0.0384 mg/kg... ketanserin (2 mg/kg) attenuated the LSD response in 50% of rats... 56% and 60% of rats pretreated with 3 and 10 mg/kg SB 699551, respectively, failed to select the LSD lever.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of rats failing to complete, number choosing LSD lever, LSD/vehicle lever responses, and response rate.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data reported as totals per session; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Lever pressing in operant chamber is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Each rat tested alone in the operant chamber.

B6_cognitive.evidence: the drug discrimination procedure is a food-motivated decision-taking task based on cognitive abilities

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The chambers were operated by Graphic State Notation v3.03 (operant control software, lever press counting only).

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses performed with separate univariate tests (chi-square, ANOVA).

E1_environment_type.evidence: Eight commercially available operant chambers (model E1010RF; Coulbourn Instruments)

E2_shelter.evidence: Operant chamber with two levers and food dispenser; no shelter.

E3_bedding.evidence: instrumental chambers were cleaned to avoid any olfactory cues; no bedding.

E6_spatial.evidence: Operant chamber consists of a single compartment with two levers.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat tested individually in the chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: in the testing session, animals ran for a single non-reinforced session; no food/water delivered during test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Animals were trained daily (Monday-Friday)... Tests were done once or twice a week

D2_session_duration.evidence: testing session... until the first subsequent 10 presses occurred on either lever or until five minutes had passed

D3_recording_days.evidence: Animals were trained daily (Monday-Friday)... rats learned the drug discrimination within approximately 40 sessions... Between June and December 2018, when the testing session were performed

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline session recorded prior to training; vehicle control sessions are not pre-drug baselines.

D5_followup.evidence: All recordings occurred 5–90 min after drug administration; no ≥24 h follow-up.

D6_circadian.evidence: Test sessions terminated after at most 5 minutes; no session spanned ≥6 h.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (two-lever drug discrimination); consolidated as one assay per rubric — different doses, antagonists, and time intervals are variants of the same paradigm.
LSD schedule resolved as 'chronic' because rats received LSD ~2× per week for many months (training Jun–Dec 2018), well beyond 8 doses / 7 days, despite each individual test being acute.
food_restriction set to 'before' (mild chronic restriction to ~17 g/day for operant motivation) — explicitly stated in Methods; overrides gptoss 'during'.
D4_baseline scored 0: vehicle+vehicle control sessions are control conditions, not pre-drug baselines recorded prior to LSD treatment in the same animals.
B1 = 2-3 (1 point): rats failing to complete, lever selection, and response rate are 3 distinct measures.
day_night_flipped = 'no' (lights on 6 am, testing in light phase) per the explicit statement in Methods.
